## Algorithm sources (ideas and constants, not copied code)
- **Bezier curve fitting** (`autotrace.rs`, `lod.rs`): the algorithm structure follows P. J. Schneider, "An Algorithm for Automatically Fitting Digitized Curves", *Graphics Gems I* (A. Glassner, ed., Academic Press, 1990); the code was written independently. The Graphics Gems code distribution states, in its README/licence note, that its code may be used in any program, product or library, commercial or not, that credit is appreciated but not required, and that it comes as-is without liability; only claiming the text of the code as one's own and reselling it is excluded. We did not copy that code; this note records the permissive terms in case a reviewer asks (verify the wording against the Graphics Gems repository README).
- **Hash constants** (`noise.rs`): xorshift-multiply finaliser from Chris Wellons' `lowbias32` (public domain, Hash Prospector, 2018); 0x9E3779B1 (2^32 / golden ratio, Knuth); 0x85EBCA6B (MurmurHash3 finaliser, Austin Appleby, public domain).
- **Easing**: `Ease::Bounce` and `Ease::Back` are own derivations (CLEANROOM.md); Robert Penner's BSD-3-Clause constants are no longer used.
- Other algorithms are listed per module with their papers and textbooks in CLEANROOM.md.

## Bundled model (attribution)
`armatura-core/models/face23_synth.bin` (a 650 KB face-detector weight file for `facedet`) is (c) 2026 Alexandru-Ionuț Chiuță (Alexio), licensed CC-BY-4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/; give credit and indicate changes). It was trained **only on faces generated by this project's own synthetic face generator** (`facegen.rs`); no photographs, no third-party datasets and no third-party pre-trained weights were used.
## Builds without the MPL-2.0+ crate (smartstring)

The table above is the union over the whole workspace with all features, where the default CLI enables `scripting` and Cargo unifies features. Checked per package with `cargo tree -i smartstring -e normal,build`:

| Build | smartstring in tree? |
|---|---|
| `-p armatura-core --no-default-features` | no |
| `-p armatura-cli --no-default-features` | no |
| `-p armatura-capi` | no |
| `-p armatura-wasm` | no |
| `-p armatura-cli` | yes |
